title: Brønsted acid-catalyzed two-component tandem condensation and cycloisomerization to 6(2H)-isoquinolinones
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,8913-8917
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01267H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Fang Yang, Lin-Lin Wang, Yu-Hua Liu, Ke-Xin Wu, Zi-Sheng Chen, Kegong Ji
A Brønsted acid-catalyzed 2-alkynyl-4-hydroxybenzaldehydes and primary amines to 6(2H)-isoquinolinones in one-pot has been reported. This protocol tolerates various commercially available amines, including chiral amino alcohols and amino acids.
